questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to model real-world tradeoffs between privacy, latency, and cost. Requires understanding of device constraints, cross-platform deployment, and regulatory risk.

## Key Concepts

- On-device ML footprint and model sizing
- Energy and CPU budgeting per user/session
- Telemetry, local storage, and data minimization
- Compliance costs and risk assessment
- Business impact metrics: incidents, trust, activation, ARPU

## Code Example

```javascript
function energyPerInference(modelSizeMB, cpuPercent, durationMs){
  // rough proxy for energy
  return modelSizeMB * cpuPercent * durationMs * 1e-6;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you model break-even if moderation incidents drop by X%?
- What telemetry would you capture and how would you protect privacy?

## Why This Is Asked

- On-device ML footprint and memory
- Privacy-by-design and consent

}

## Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to translate business impact into technical rollout decisions, including statistical thinking and cost models.

## Key Concepts
- Cost-benefit modeling
- A/B testing & uplift estimation
- Edge compute cost vs latency trade-offs
- Rollout policy and monitoring

## Code Example
```javascript
function shouldRollout(uplift, arpu, users, cost, threshold){
  const revenue = uplift * arpu * users;
  const net = revenue - cost;
  return net >= threshold;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle uplift uncertainty (CI) in decision?
- How would you budget rollouts across regions with variable costs?
